# UiAlert

An inline message with an intent, optional title, actions and dismissal.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | feedback |
| Import | `import { UiAlert } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiAlert from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiAlert'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/feedback/UiAlert.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/feedback/UiAlert.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `UiColor` |  | Colour role. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `variant` | `'solid' \| 'soft' \| 'outline'` |  | Visual variant. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |
| `description` | `string` |  | Body text. Use the default slot for rich content. |
| `icon` | `UiIconDefinition \| null` |  | Glyph. Defaults to one matching `color`; pass `null` for none. The glyph is decorative: the text carries the meaning. |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a dismiss button. Pair with `v-model:open` to control visibility. |
| `announce` | `'auto' \| 'polite' \| 'assertive' \| 'off'` | `'auto'` | Live-region behaviour. `auto` uses `role="alert"` for error/warning and `role="status"` otherwise; `off` renders a static note (use that for content that is present when the page loads). |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model:open` | `boolean` | default `true` | Whether it is open. Stays in sync with the native element, however it was opened or closed. |

## Events

| Event | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dismiss` | `[]` | The dismiss button was activated. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` |  | Body content (replaces `description`). |
| `title` |  | Replaces `title`. |
| `icon` |  | Replaces the glyph. |
| `actions` |  | Buttons or links related to the message. |

## Attributes

The root `<div>`.

## Keyboard

- The dismiss button is a normal button (Enter/Space).

## Accessibility

- `announce="auto"`: `role="alert"` for error/warning, `role="status"` otherwise; `off` renders a static note.
- Intent is conveyed by the title/text and an icon, not by colour alone.
- The dismiss button has a translated accessible name.

## Styling

- `.vui-alert`, `.vui-alert__icon`, `.vui-alert__title`, `.vui-alert__description`, `.vui-alert__actions`
- `data-color`, `data-variant`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/FeedbackDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/FeedbackDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-2">
  <UiAlert
    v-for="intent in intents"
    :key="intent"
    :color="intent"
    announce="off"
    :title="t(`demo.alert.title.${intent}`)"
    :description="t(`demo.alert.${intent}`)"
  />
  <UiAlert
    v-model:open="dismissed"
    color="warning"
    variant="outline"
    announce="off"
    dismissible
    :title="t('demo.alert.title.warning')"
  >
    {{ t('demo.alert.warning') }}
    <template #actions>
      <UiButton size="sm" variant="outline" color="warning">{{ t('demo.continue') }}</UiButton>
    </template>
  </UiAlert>
  <UiAlert
    color="error"
    variant="solid"
    announce="off"
    :title="t('demo.alert.title.error')"
    :description="t('demo.alert.error')"
  />
</div>
```
